designation: provisional, prior-exposed within-pair TEACHER AGREEMENT development probe
task: VUH-1353: one frozen-feature replay-to-live linear residual probe
inputs: Existing released prepared stores only, through unchanged reviewed v3 boundary/read/review/pairing/model-loading path. No added data paths or sources.
mapping: replay=live-30.600 seconds, unchanged v3 nearest native-PTS pairing; no tuning or shifts

split.convention: Half-open intervals. Both live and nominal replay complete 17-frame context footprints (replay PTS mapped by +30.600) must lie entirely in one block. Any footprint crossing 145 is purged. The label interval start/end is already contained in that footprint.
split.assertion: Fit/report native frame ordinal sets must be disjoint in BOTH stores. No hidden-frame overlap. No data-driven split changes.
split.exposure: The last block was previously scored/viewed. This is a temporally separated report block within an exposed pair, not blind validation or generalization.

frozen_teacher: LIVE full03 camera predictions, including original _camera reference gains, uncertainty masks and pitch-fix A. No logger truth.
features: Replay 128-dimensional penultimate camera-head ReLU activation (model.camera[1]), obtained by hook during frozen eval/inference_mode forward. All full03 parameters requires_grad=False; no update.
masks: Joint original known-mask intersection: LIVE and nominal REPLAY yaw and pitch all answered. Fit/report residual, affine, unchanged and zero use identical joint-known rows. Corrected methods inherit these masks; no re-masking or promotion.
normalization: Feature mean and population standard deviation from FIT joint-known rows ONLY. Divide by max(std,1e-6). No dimension selection; all 128 features. Report block cannot change normalization.

residual.form: corrected replay = unchanged replay + standardized replay hidden features @ B + c
residual.objective: mean squared residual-target error per axis + lambda*sum(B[:,axis]^2); intercept unpenalized
residual.solve: One deterministic float64 multi-output ridge normal-equation solve, (Z.T@Z/n + lambda*I)^-1@(Z.T@(LIVE-REPLAY-centered)/n). B has 128x2 parameters; c is 2-dimensional mean training residual. No optimizer, search, retry or checkpoint update.
residual.fit_count: One real-data multi-output residual fit; separately prespecified affine comparator only. Synthetic tests are not real-data fits.

affine: Per-axis training-only ordinary least squares LIVE=a*REPLAY+b, computed from fit means/covariance. If replay variance <=1e-12, a=0 and b=mean FIT teacher. No regularization/tuning.
metrics: MAE and RMSE against frozen LIVE teacher
active-row mean-absolute magnitude ratio versus teacher
movement_sign_recall: On report rows with abs(teacher)>=0.1: correct sign AND abs(method)>=0.1. Zero always fails. Report both numerator and denominator.

axis_positive_gate.agreement: Residual MAE at least 1% lower than BOTH unchanged and affine, and strictly lower than zero. Residual RMSE no greater than EITHER unchanged or affine.
axis_positive_gate.no_flattening: Residual RMS, centered std, and active-row mean absolute magnitude each at least 80% of teacher. Active-row sign recall at least 80%, and no more than 2 percentage points below either unchanged or affine. Missing/zero teacher denominator makes this gate inconclusive, not positive.
axis_positive_gate.decision: Any failed gate: do not expand that axis. A positive axis is only within-pair teacher-agreement evidence; no expansion or new data access is authorized by this run.

outputs: D:/rivals-agent-evidence/idm-paired-camera-distillation-20260929. Aggregate report/per-second visual, parameter coefficients with non-deployment designation, input/code hashes. No feature/teacher row cache, targets or label export. No checkpoint promotion.
execution: CPU BelowNormal, Torch intraop2/interop1, no decode/cloud/sealed data. One exclusive start record prevents retries. Check fixed deadline throughout extraction and before/after fit. Stop after one fit/report.
interpretation: Agreement with a frozen teacher is not physical accuracy or generalization. The pre-existing discrepancy does not prove replay is worse.
